Congress candidate Ketan Bhatikar appealed to the Supreme Court (filed Apr 2026); no final SC ruling was found as of 2026-09-25.

It is in the South Goa Lok Sabha seat under the 2008 delimitation, although the district was North Goa until Dec 2025.
